verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints that balances can earn. First-party docs list "cash rewards" among the financial account features available in the prebuilt embedded UI, and a community thread refers to Treasury's interest-earning feature for balances. That same thread asks openly who gets paid the interest, which shows the economics are not spelled out in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented interest-bearing account or sweep mechanics, rate-setting and accrual details, explicit disclosure of who keeps the spread, independent hands-on corroboration.
